messages:
rachel: quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: GPU supply, regional rollouts, and autoscale behaviors. keeping it short for folks who asked for a single thread.
omar: APAC teams asked for an ETA on T4s for burst testing. any firm windows?
rachel: short timeline: T4 burst pockets for APAC targeted mid-July for pilot; reserved/dedicated capacity late Q3. exact zones + capacity numbers in next week's note.
ben: ops needs deterministic prewarm guidance (not just a ballpark). what formula should teams use?
rachel: recommended formula: prewarm_slots = ceil(route_qps * p95_latency_s * 1.6). example: qps=10, p95=0.4s => 10*0.4*1.6=6.4 -> 7 slots. default per-major-region: 150 slots; APAC pilot start: 50.
sylvia: can we confirm autoscaler pool preference order? critical for route config.
rachel: yes: 1) Dedicated/reserved 2) Prewarm pool 3) Burst (spot/partner) 4) Model fallbacks (quantized/smaller). we try to avoid spot variability for p95-sensitive routes.
omar: if burst gets evicted, do we queue or immediately downgrade?
rachel: eviction plan: short retry window (200ms) to grab prewarm/reserved, then switch to quantized/smaller model. only return 503 if all fallbacks exhausted. we also expose an eviction_count metric.
ben: billing question: will hosted customers see prewarm as a separate line item?
rachel: yes  hosted PAYG will have a "prewarm" line; Dedicated includes prewarm in commit. teams can opt out per-route.
sylvia: example autoscaler snippet for product teams?
rachel: dropping a compact example teams can copy: ```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 2
  prewarm_slots: 50
  burst_qps_threshold: 120
  scale_up_cooldown_s: 30
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 300
  eviction_retry_ms: 200
  fallback_order: [reserved, prewarm, burst, quantized-variant]
```
infra-bot: notes + deck -> https://redwood.company/all-hands/2026-03-20 (deck v10.3).
rachel: action items: infra to publish a "GPU pressure playbook" by Friday (owner: omar) with alert thresholds and paging matrix; product teams DM latency-critical routes for APAC pilot prioritization. scheduling 30m route-mapping sync Tue 10am PT (invite from ben).
omar: acknowledged, will own playbook.
ben: confirmed invite sent.
rachel: thanks all
